That case (distinguished occurrence in the right-hand side, conclusion with the replacement on that side) must be written with its (P1)/(P2) steps. Both cases must be written out so that every guarantee of the selected equality-complete connection is proved; the w02b-p02-026 files are not editable hosts of this packet, so the text goes in the packet's owned annex.
